title: Thank you for 1500 users!!
body:
Thank you guys so so so much for 1500 users. Please let me know if you want any more features. I've been trying to do milestone features but the milestones are just going by.

This update is about listening together. Listen along now works across Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music and TIDAL. If Cadence can't start the song for you, start it yourself and it keeps you in time.

Join the Discord for bug reports and feature additions!!
